editor.clickAnItemToJumpToTheAffectedLin: Click an item to jump to the affected line. If a fix is available, apply it from the editor’s lightbulb.
editor.clickBetweenTheLineNumberAndBytec: Click between the line number and bytecode offset to set a breakpoint. Run will pause just before that instruction.
editor.couldNotLoadTheInstructionReferen: Could not load the instruction reference. Check your connection and reopen the tab.
editor.couldNotReadTheWorkerResponse: Could not read the worker response.
editor.editContainsFindReplaceAndFormatt: Edit contains find, replace and formatting commands. Typing an instruction shows completions; hovering it shows stack changes.
editor.holdATabBrieflyThenDragItToAnothe: Hold a tab briefly, then drag it to another group. Drag it outside the window to detach it. Drag a group boundary to resize it.
editor.openJALOrClassFilesFromFileOpenWh: Open JAL or class files from File → Open. When a folder is open, Save writes your changes into that folder.
editor.pressRunAndCheckTheOutputInConsol: Press Run and check the output in Console. The same button stops a running program.
editor.programOutputAppearsHereIfTheProg: Program output appears here. If the program needs input, fill in standard input before running it.
editor.runOneInstructionAtATime: Run one instruction at a time
editor.searchByInstructionNameOrDescript: Search by instruction name or description. Clicking an instruction in the editor opens its explanation. Hover an instruction in an example to see stack changes.
editor.seeStackLocalVariableAndBranchDep: See stack, local-variable and branch dependencies in a graph. Toggle line types with the checkboxes above, and drag to move the graph.
editor.stoppedBecauseTheTimeLimitWasExce: Stopped because the time limit was exceeded.
editor.theExampleFolderContainsRunnableS: The example folder contains runnable samples. Open one and try editing it. Open your own folder from File → Open folder.
editor.useBuildToCheckCodeOrExportCompil: Use Build to check code or export compiled class files.
editor.useTheArrowButtonsToStepThroughEx: Use the arrow buttons to step through execution. Step into enters a called method; step out returns to the caller. Inspect the stack and local variables in Frames.
editor.useViewToChangeTheThemeOrReopenAC: Use View to change the theme or reopen a closed panel. Press Shift twice to search files and OpenJDK definitions.
editor.writeAStringToStandardInstruction: Write a string to standard {0} {1} (3 instructions)
